battle_phases.completion_condition: Both medics are deployed at second 58 and opening hostile queues remain contained.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An opening death or missed grant invalidates the subsequent fixed deployment and interception schedule.
battle_phases.goal: Establish four independent interceptions and the economy supporting the medical formation.
handoff_requirements: Ansel inherits central healing at 44; neither medic is credited with healing outside its range.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla share central combat.
Midnight and Melantha handle their outer runners and roadblocks.
Lancet supplies opening treatment before withdrawal.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage starts with ten DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Opening blockers must survive long enough to deliver their specified handoffs.
Fang and Vanilla must remain alive for the counted DP grants.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Ansel's first enhancement completes, Lava is deployed and the eastern roadblocks are cleared before dangerous civilian detention.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Loss of medicine repeats the prior caster collapse; failed eastern clearance exposes a detained civilian to later pressure.
battle_phases.goal: Prevent the first medical collapse and establish both eastern damage responsibilities.
handoff_requirements: Midnight leaves only after his opening hostile interception is complete.
Lava inherits all remaining #4 damage at 94.
responsibilities: Midnight hands unfinished #4 to Lava; Steward begins upper eastern damage.
battle_phases.start_condition: Both medics are deployed and opening outer combat continues.
survival_dependencies: Ansel must survive the lower artillery exposure rather than merely reach skill readiness.
Hibiscus must continue reciprocal healing without consuming unsupported talent effects.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Durin has completed his eastern assignment, both outer defenders are established and Midnight has replaced Vanilla.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A dead caster loses both artillery output and central clearance; a dead blocker permits armor leaks even if both civilians arrive.
battle_phases.goal: Maintain artillery damage and living central blockers through the first armored arrivals.
handoff_requirements: No upper caster occupancy gap at 105.
Gallus must clear #1 before leaving at 116.
Lava's withdrawal at 146 must follow her lower eastern damage duty.
responsibilities: Beagle and Cardigan intercept later outer officers.
Ansel enhances at 129 and Hibiscus at 148.
Midnight takes lower central blocking at 152.
battle_phases.start_condition: Hibiscus enhances at 98 and both eastern damage positions are occupied.
survival_dependencies: Both medics and the active casters must survive their actual impact and healing sequence.
The interval between Hibiscus's first enhancement and Ansel's second is an unverified survival dependency.
Fang and Vanilla must retain their tiles until their replacements arrive.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both protected arrivals are confirmed and the artillery has an actual death event before its exit.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Surviving artillery can leak regardless of protected arrivals; insufficient central clearance can independently exceed block capacity.
battle_phases.goal: Release the second civilian and kill the artillery before its modeled exit.
handoff_requirements: Steward's 105 withdrawal must permit his 175 return.
Fang remains until Noir Corne is deployed on the same frame.
battle_phases.start_condition: Cardigan protects the lower outer corridor and Melantha begins #2 clearance.
survival_dependencies: Ansel must survive as the sole medic from 174 to 244.
Western Steward must receive sufficient actual attacks on artillery despite competing upper central enemies.

battle_phases.completion_condition: The complete acceptance predicate holds; elapsed time alone never completes the phase.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leak or protected death rejects the plan; unresolved enemies after the listed timeline mean incomplete clearance, not a win.
battle_phases.goal: Clear every remaining hostile while retaining both protected successes.
handoff_requirements: Respect Durin's and Hibiscus's exact cooldowns.
Retain the final formation and scheduled skills while hostile queues remain.
responsibilities: Durin restores continuous central arts at 237.
Both outer defenders remain until their queues are empty.
battle_phases.start_condition: The western artillery window ends and the final officer, runner and armor waves are active.
survival_dependencies: Ansel sustains the formation until Hibiscus returns.
Noir Corne and Midnight must contain queues until arts damage clears them.
Outer defender survival also requires adequate ordinary attack clearance.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward, Durin, Lava and western Steward divide the artillery route by the stated handoffs. Record actual artillery hits separately from attacks diverted into central enemies or devices.
Melantha clears #3 and Gallus clears #1. Beagle intercepts later upper officers. Count the first protected arrival independently.
Midnight and Lava clear #4. Cardigan separates lower officers from the detained civilian while Melantha clears #2. Count the second protected arrival independently.
Fang then Noir Corne contain upper central traffic. Eastern casters, adjacent Midnight, western Steward and final Durin provide the required clearance.
Vanilla then Midnight contain lower central traffic. Reciprocal medicine must survive the first armor arrivals; Midnight's arts and final Durin clear armor.
Melantha handles the opening; Beagle owns subsequent upper outer officers until every queued officer is dead.
Midnight handles the opening; Cardigan owns subsequent lower outer officers. Do not substitute a slower attacker without checking queue clearance.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper central interception and conditional automatic DP until second 179.
Opening lower central interception and manual DP until second 152.
Opening lower outer interception and eastern lower roadblock damage.
Opening upper outer interception and roadblock #3 clearance.
Opening healing and supported deployment heal; withdraw at second 45.
Early lower medical enhancement; cover both central blockers, Hibiscus and both column-6 eastern casters.
Upper medical enhancement and reciprocal support of Ansel and the eastern casters.
Initial upper eastern artillery damage and central clearance.
Finish roadblock #4, then damage the lower eastern artillery window; credit individual arts hits only.
Fresh upper eastern successor after Steward's explicit withdrawal.
Upper outer officer containment and clearance.
Lower outer officer containment and clearance, east of the second civilian's western roadblock.
Second deployment clears roadblock #2 behind Cardigan.
Fresh lower central blocker, adjacent upper central assistance and repeatable arts clearance.
Western artillery finish and upper central damage after Hibiscus vacates this tile.
Replace Fang with fresh three-block upper central containment.
Terminal continuous arts covering both central blocking positions.
Restore the second medic after cooldown, covering Ansel and central defenders.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward owns upper eastern damage from 70 to 105, Durin from 105 to 167, and redeployed Steward owns the western finish from 175. Lava owns lower eastern damage from 94 to 146. These ranges also contain competing targets; deployment duration is not credited as uninterrupted artillery damage.
formation_structure.central_transition: Midnight replaces Vanilla at 152 before the first recorded armor leaks. Noir Corne replaces Fang at 179, adding block capacity while supported arts operators perform clearance.
formation_structure.medical_change: Ansel occupies the lower medical position from second 44; Hibiscus occupies the upper position from second 58. Their basic rectangular ranges cover each other, both central blockers and both column-6 eastern damage positions. Lower enhancement starts at 69; upper enhancement starts at 98.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla mutually assist across the two central rows. Midnight and Melantha intercept the separate outer streams while damaging their eastern roadblocks.
formation_structure.outer_defense: Beagle and Cardigan remain on their respective outer lanes. Cardigan's ordinary attack output, rather than an unsupported healing skill, is required to clear successive officers.
formation_structure.terminal: Noir Corne, Midnight, Beagle, Cardigan, Ansel, Steward, Durin and Hibiscus form the final eight deployments.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet while alive; Ansel inherits supported central treatment, but does not inherit nonexistent coverage of Midnight's outer tile.
Activate lower Ansel before the previous frame-2280 medical collapse; this is a survival intervention, not an assumed DP correction.
Withdraw opening Midnight after his hostile interception duty; Lava will inherit unfinished roadblock #4 at second 94.
Withdraw Melantha after upper opening clearance; preserve her cooldown for second 146.
Enhance upper Hibiscus before the recorded upper eastern impact interval.
Withdraw Steward and deploy fresh Durin on the same tile, in that order.
Withdraw Gallus after western upper clearance and deploy Beagle before the paired upper officers reach the interception tile.
Deploy Cardigan before the paired lower officers reach [6,4].
Withdraw Lava after the lower eastern stop; deploy Melantha behind Cardigan to clear roadblock #2.
Withdraw Vanilla and immediately deploy fresh Midnight on [4,5].
Withdraw Durin after the eastern coverage interval; his next deployment is second 237.
Withdraw Melantha after western lower roadblock clearance.
Withdraw Hibiscus from [2,5]; Ansel inherits sole medical responsibility during the western finish.
Redeploy Steward facing LEFT on Hibiscus's vacated tile after his exact 70-second cooldown.
Withdraw Fang and deploy Noir Corne on the vacated upper central tile.
Restore Durin in the lower high-ground position for terminal central arts.
Restore Hibiscus on the vacant upper column-6 tile after her exact cooldown.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true. No mode-specific reserve unit is legal.
All deployment tiles are integer [row,col], with an explicit UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT direction. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
Never exceed eight deployed operators; same-frame withdrawals precede replacement deployments. No refund is included in the budget.
Fang and Vanilla must survive through the grants supporting later deployments. A missing grant is a failed survival or handoff dependency, not an arithmetic discrepancy.
Ansel must remain deployed for the second-69 intervention; both medics must survive the upper and lower eastern windows. Scheduled enhancements provide no benefit after death.
Steward explicitly leaves at 105, Durin immediately inherits, and Steward returns at 175. Actual artillery damage must continue despite competing central targets; no priority is assumed.
Vanilla remains alive until Midnight's second-152 replacement. Fang remains alive until Noir Corne's second-179 replacement. Block capacity alone does not establish sufficient clearance.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Intercept officers east of western civilian detention and require both actual safe-arrival events.

Require #3 cleared before Melantha's first withdrawal, #1 before Gallus leaves, #4 cleared before the second civilian's eastern detention becomes dangerous, and #2 cleared before Melantha's second withdrawal.

Accept only remaining_life > 0, zero enemy leaks, exhausted hostile spawns, no active hostile enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely arrived. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish four interceptions, source-backed economy and both medics. Withdraw Lancet before her prior death window.
Use Ansel's early enhancement to sustain the lower formation. Establish both eastern damage positions and finish the eastern civilian roadblocks.
Use Hibiscus's enhancement through the upper exposure window; execute the fresh Durin handoff and establish both permanent outer blockers.
Use Ansel's next enhancement, then Hibiscus's second enhancement, through lower artillery exposure and armor arrivals. Release the second civilian and replace Vanilla.
Steward must finish the artillery before its modeled exit while Ansel sustains central interception. Noir Corne inherits upper blocking without an empty-tile interval.
Midnight supplies central arts; retain both outer defenders and restore Durin and Hibiscus after cooldown.
Maintain healing, blocking and arts until all hostile queues are empty and both protected arrivals are confirmed.

Activate at 25,55,85,115,145; account for each ten-second active SP pause.
Opening arts at 65. Redeployment at 152 resets readiness: activate at 192,302,412, respecting forty active seconds and seventy charging seconds.
Opening ATK enhancement at 70; second deployment clears #2 with ordinary attacks.
Enhance lower medicine at 69,129,189,249,309,369,429. Credit supported ATK enhancement; no probabilistic extra healing.
First two enhancements at 98 and 148. After returning at 244, activate at 274,324,374,424. Credit no unsupported talent ATK.
Deployment at 94 plus supported deployment SP permits readiness at 104; activate at 116 for the lower eastern stop. Credit no splash geometry.
DEF enhancement at 156,226,296,366,436; no unsupported passive DEF bonus.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks. Credit neither highest-defense targeting nor talent ATK; redeployment resets attack SP.
Use ordinary attacks and blocking only; exclude unsupported self-healing, defensive talents, evasion and RES reduction.

tactical_thesis: Exchange the medics' upper and lower responsibilities so Ansel's deployment SP enables lower-sector healing enhancement at second 69, before the previous first medical collapse. Reserve Hibiscus's first enhancement for the upper eastern attack window. Budget deployments without refunds, explicitly replace Steward with Durin, and replace the lower central vanguard before armored pressure develops. Cardigan owns sustained lower outer clearance; Noir Corne later supplies three-block upper central containment. Preserve civilian release responsibilities while treating artillery death, medical survival and zero leaks as separate requirements.
